div.div: The documented hierarchy runs organization › campus › building › level › space › desk group › desk. The current REST API exposes desks, seat reservations, free-busy search, visits, SCIM and inbound presence. Location, Space and Organization come from the archived Java SDK, and neighbourhoods are readable only through the MCP server.
